advisories.title: SQL injection via metadata filter key in SQLite checkpointer
advisories.detail: User-controlled filter keys are interpolated into checkpoint queries without parameterization, enabling SQL injection that can chain to RCE via forged checkpoint rows.

advisories.title: Unsafe msgpack deserialization in checkpoint loading
advisories.detail: LangGraph checkpoint loading deserializes msgpack payloads unsafely; a crafted checkpoint can execute code during load.

advisories.title: Unsafe JSON deserialization in checkpoint loading
advisories.detail: Checkpoint loading deserializes JSON payloads without type restrictions, allowing untrusted-data deserialization.

advisories.title: Path traversal in legacy load_prompt functions
advisories.detail: Legacy prompt-loading APIs resolve user-supplied paths without containment, permitting arbitrary file read via path traversal. See also LD304 (load_prompt usage).

advisories.title: Serialization-injection secret extraction in dumps/loads
advisories.detail: Crafted serialized payloads inject attributes during load, enabling extraction of secrets embedded in serialized objects. Fixed on both the 0.3.x and 1.x lines. (CNA scores 9.3; NVD scores 8.2.)

advisories.title: Unauthenticated RCE in /api/v1/validate/code
advisories.detail: Missing authentication on the code-validation endpoint lets a remote, unauthenticated attacker execute arbitrary code via crafted HTTP requests (Python decorator / default-argument abuse). Exploited in the wild to deploy the Flodrix botnet; added to CISA KEV on 2025-05-05.

advisories.title: BaseCache deserialization of untrusted data may lead to RCE
advisories.detail: The BaseCache implementation deserializes untrusted cached data, which can lead to remote code execution.

advisories.title: RCE in "json" mode of JsonPlusSerializer
advisories.detail: The JsonPlusSerializer in "json" mode reconstructs arbitrary objects during deserialization, enabling remote code execution.

advisories.title: SQL injection in the SQLite store implementation
advisories.detail: The SQLite store implementation is vulnerable to SQL injection. Distinct from LD101 (fixed 3.0.1): a project pinned between 2.0.11 and 3.0.1 is safe from this one but still exposed to LD101.

advisories.title: SQL injection via filter key in SqliteStore
advisories.detail: Filter keys passed to SqliteStore are interpolated into queries unsafely, enabling SQL injection (public PoC).

advisories.title: Path traversal to RCE via /api/v2/files upload
advisories.detail: upload_user_file() does not sanitize the multipart filename, allowing path traversal to write arbitrary files (escalating to RCE via cron/config overwrite). Unauthenticated when auto-login is enabled (see LD403). Actively exploited (VulnCheck). Also fixed in langflow-base 0.8.3. NOT yet indexed by OSV at build time; likely the same root cause as OSV's CVE-2026-33309 (arbitrary file write via v2 API, fixed 1.9.0) — recorded as a hypothesis, not hard-merged.

advisories.title: Unsafe URL path construction in LangGraph SDK
advisories.detail: The LangGraph SDK builds request URLs from unsanitized path segments, letting a caller-controlled value alter the request target. Only the 0.x line is affected (fixed 0.3.15); 1.x is not. CNA (GitHub) scores this 4.2 medium; an NVD secondary analyst assigns a maximal-impact 9.1 vector inconsistent with the SDK URL-construction root cause, so the CNA score is used here.

advisories.title: Template injection via attribute access in prompt templates
advisories.detail: Prompt templates evaluate attribute access on template variables, so a crafted template string can traverse object attributes to read sensitive values (e.g. secrets reachable from a passed object). Fixed on both the 0.3.x and 1.x lines. Scored with CVSS 4.0 (base 8.3).

advisories.title: Path traversal and sandbox escape in file-search middleware and loaders
advisories.detail: The file-search middleware and several document loaders resolve user-influenced paths without containment, permitting path traversal and sandbox escape to read files outside the intended root. Local vector, high attack complexity, confidentiality impact.

advisories.title: Langflow older than the current secure baseline (1.10.1)
advisories.detail: Langflow has a large and fast-moving CVE history. Versions below 1.10.1 carry multiple known vulnerabilities beyond those enumerated individually here. Upgrade to the latest release. (Aggregate advisory: the engine suppresses this when a more specific Langflow finding already fired for the same install.)
